8.19.8. iLock_Geography.lcf.parse.ParRule¶

class iLock_Geography.lcf.parse.ParRule(source, paramName, tableName, namespace, columns, returnCol=None, default=None)¶

Represents a parameter rule from a LCF2Par file.
